blocks.text: Central Meadows homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Central Meadows, September 2026. Detached houses: 15 listed at month end and 4 sold in September, a sales ratio of 27% (a sellers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 32 listed at month end and 5 sold in September, a sales ratio of 16% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 16 sold over 4 months against an average of 19.0 listed, about 4.8 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 5 sold. Condos and townhomes: 25 sold over 4 months against an average of 32.5 listed, about 5.2 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 8 sold.
